description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of character types within the RoleplayPref dataset. The chart contains thirteen slices, representing categories such as Movie Characters, Novel Characters, Game Characters, and others including Scientists, Athletes, Musicians, and Influencers. The slices are colored in shades of blue, pink, and green. Approximate proportions, visually estimated, are as follows: Movie Characters occupy approximately 25%, Novel Characters around 20%, Game Characters roughly 15%, Custom Characters about 10%, Virtual Characters around 8%, Teleplay Characters and Real Characters each approximately 6%, Scientists, Athletes, Writers, and Musicians each appear to be around 3-4%, and Actors and Influencers each represent approximately 1-2% of the total. A legend is provided labeling each slice. The slices are arranged in clockwise order and appear to be ordered from largest to smallest proportionate size. Percentage labels are not displayed within the slices, and no slices are visually emphasized.
